extraction.disclaimer_span: We do not offer every plan available in your area. Currently we represent 26 organizations which offer 3,740 products in your area. Please contact Medicare.gov or 1-800-MEDICARE to get information on all of your options.
extraction.soa_span: I've sent the Scope of Appointment to your email so we can go over specific plans. Can you sign it while we're on the line?

composition.summary: The agent delivered the TPMO disclaimer before discussing benefits, collected the Scope of Appointment, and scheduled an appointment 3 days from now. However, the agent made no superlative claims.
composition.coaching_note: Luis, you did a great job delivering the disclaimer and collecting the SOA. However, you could improve by providing more specific information about the plan's benefits and limitations. For example, you mentioned the $30 monthly premium, but didn't explain what that means for the customer's out-of-pocket costs.

crm_record.next_step: Follow-up on appointment 3 days from now
